linear_seeds: Six constraint-consistent basis columns in (d,T,fu,fchi,wu,wchi), field columns normalized by sqrt(a). They are response fixtures, not primordial modes.
high_k_initial: d=1,T=-fg+3(fg-1)Plead,fu=-sqrt(a)D/Q,fchi=0,wu=(fg-1)fu,wchi=0; P set by exact energy constraint. a=0 is a separate GR dust control with unexcited fields.
high_k_ratio_error_note: Check absolute endpoint coefficient error <=20/q0^2; rows also report errors. Not a general finite-k theorem or primordial amplitude prediction.
growth_initial_note: Dg amplitude normalized arbitrarily to1; derivative1 at z=1000 approximates regular matter mode. Independently compare integral growing solution; no radiation included.
homogeneous_seeds: All5 axes; field displacements sqrt(a)*eps, velocity displacements sqrt(a)*Hi*eps, log(sigma) displacement eps; plus and minus each.
EG_source: arXiv1003.2185 submitted version, primary PDF page6; exposed before fixture freeze. No source catalogue or supplemental correction rerun.
EG_data_role: Exposed published-summary diagnostic under stated estimator bridge. No fitted coupling, matter fraction or independent holdout.
